# co-equal facet

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:coequalFacet`](gmeow-coequalFacet.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/coequalFacet>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/kernel`](../../slices/kernel.md)

Marks a property as one co-equal identity-facet axis among peers (CONSTITUTION P9). Every property annotated [`coequalFacet`](gmeow-coequalFacet.md) true is held orthogonal to every other by the generated reasoning lint: its range is its own (distinct from every other axis), no [rdfs:subPropertyOf](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#subPropertyOf) or [owl:equivalentProperty](http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#equivalentProperty) bridge may connect two axes, none may be [owl:FunctionalProperty](http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#FunctionalProperty) (a single locked value invites exactly the [owl:sameAs](http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#sameAs) collapse [Principle 5](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-5) forbids), and all axis ranges must be jointly declared [owl:AllDisjointClasses.](http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#AllDisjointClasses.) A new annotated axis receives [Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9) enforcement by construction.
